## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Special issue of Science highlights advancements in chronic pain and menopause](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/01/womens-health-issues-academic-journal-science-special-edition/)** — *STAT*
  * A special women's health edition of *Science* highlights recent discoveries and addresses key open questions regarding the biological mechanisms of chronic pain and menopause.

* **[Urinary cell-free RNA profiling demonstrates high sensitivity in bladder cancer detection](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04673-3)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Evaluated in over 600 patients and controls, urinary cell-free RNA profiling using uRARE-seq showed high sensitivity for detecting bladder cancer.
  * The urinary cell-free RNA signature also correlated with patient treatment response, demonstrating potential as a non-invasive longitudinal biomarker.

* **[Computational tool standardizes plasma pTau217 results across diverse platforms](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.28.26363900)** — *Research Paper*
  * The Deming regression-based tool Biomarker Convert successfully transformed plasma pTau217 concentrations across three major assays (LC-MS/MS, Janssen Simoa, and Lumipulse).
  * While absolute concentrations differed across platforms, the assays demonstrated similar predictive accuracy for amyloid-β positivity (AUC = 0.929–0.952), allowing standardized screening to optimize clinical trial recruitment.

* **[Dermatological AI system matches human experts in clinical and home settings](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.30.26364271)** — *Research Paper*
  * A computer-vision AI system was compared with an expert human panel for grading facial features across three acquisition settings: Standard Studio Imaging (SSI), Clinic Smartphone Imaging (CSI), and Home Smartphone Imaging (HSI).
  * The AI demonstrated high operator-independent test-retest repeatability (median ICC = 0.97–0.98) and maintained high correlation with experts for macro-geometric features (ptosis ρ = 0.74–0.81, nasolabial fold ρ = 0.68–0.79) across all settings.

* **[Esophageal String Test proteome defines EoE luminal signature](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.30.26364161)** — *Research Paper*
  * Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry of esophageal String Test (EST) samples identified over 3,000 proteins.
  * The analysis established a distinct luminal protein signature associated with active eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE), differentiating it from gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and healthy controls.

* **[Epigenetic proxy MaGE provides scalable in vivo measure of cellular senescence](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364335)** — *Research Paper*
  * Researchers developed Methylation-associated Gene Expression (MaGE) predictors, which use whole-blood DNA methylation as proxies for p14ARF, p16INK4A, and p21CIP1 expression.
  * Analysis across the Generation Scotland cohort (n = 18,859) revealed 45 significant associations across 18 incident diseases and all-cause mortality, with MaGE-p21 strongly associating with incident alcoholic liver disease and MaGE-p16 with pulmonary fibrosis.

* **[Autoantibody profiling implicates ZnT8 as a key antigenic target in rheumatoid arthritis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.26364002)** — *Research Paper*
  * A study evaluating diabetes-related autoantibodies in 326 diabetes-free rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients found ZnT8 autoantibodies (ZnT8ab) in 86% of female patients.
  * ZnT8ab-positive women exhibited higher insulin levels and HOMA-IR indices, alongside lower serum concentrations of IL-6, IFNγ, and IL-9.

* **[Raman spectroscopy of sweat-derived extracellular vesicles identifies dementia signatures](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.26364001)** — *Research Paper*
  * A proof-of-concept cross-sectional study (n = 88) utilized label-free Raman spectroscopy of sweat-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) to discriminate patients with dementia from healthy controls.
  * The method successfully differentiated Alzheimer's disease (AD) from frontotemporal dementia (FTD) and identified sex-specific spectral signatures.

* **[COL4A2 mutation links ryanodine receptor remodeling to cerebral pial artery dysfunction](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.754477)** — *Research Paper*
  * Aged (12-month-old) heterozygous Col4a2+/G646D mice exhibited selective impairment of pressure-induced myogenic tone in cerebral pial arteries, while downstream parenchymal arterioles remained unaffected.
  * The vascular defect was driven by an increased frequency of subcellular Ca²⁺ sparks from ryanodine receptor 2 (RyR2) and elevated large-conductance Ca²⁺-activated K⁺ (BK) channel activity in smooth muscle cells.

* **[Biotech]** **[Century Therapeutics advances CNTY-813 toward clinical entry](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105994154597925324)** — *BioStocks*
  * Presented nonclinical data for CNTY-813 at the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) meeting.
  * IND submission remains on track for Q4, with initial clinical data expected in 2H 2027.

* **Other key translational and biomarker updates:**
  * *Preclinical Spheroid Model:* A human-induced pluripotent stem cell-derived spheroid model was developed to study myelin injury and repair [Research Paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42823475/).
  * *RA Diagnostic Biomarkers:* Proteomic analysis using MudPIT identified transforming growth factor-beta-1 (TGF-β-1)-induced protein and serum amyloid A autoantibodies as promising diagnostic biomarkers for rheumatoid arthritis [Research Paper](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.26361099).
  * *At-Home Neuromodulation Biomarkers:* Chronic recording of local field potentials (LFPs) via an at-home subcallosal cingulate cortex (SCC) deep brain stimulation (DBS) platform successfully tracked depression recovery in treatment-resistant patients [Research Paper](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.13.26350107).
  * *Schizophrenia Polygenic Risk:* Machine learning applied to 413 psychiatry-relevant polygenic scores stratified patients into two genetic risk profiles (GRPs); GRP 1 was characterized by high neuroticism, depression predisposition, lower cognitive performance, and a more severe clinical phenotype [Research Paper](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.04.29.25326656).
  * *CT Radiomics in Melanoma:* An evaluation of metastatic melanoma patients showed that CT radiomics features did not improve prediction of early lesion-level size response to immunotherapy beyond simple volume dynamics [Research Paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42823717/).
  * *HRD in Rectal Cancer:* Homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) score was evaluated for its association with the efficacy of neoadjuvant short-course radiotherapy plus sequential chemoimmunotherapy in pMMR locally advanced rectal cancer [Research Paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42822843/).
  * *StrokeAgent Multimodal AI:* Researchers introduced StrokeAgent, a multimodal agentic framework that integrates clinical records, ECGs, and CT images to provide auditable, real-time decision support across the acute stroke pathway [Research Paper](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.24.26363786).
  * *Depression Speech AI in AD:* An explainable multimodal framework used cross-dataset transfer to map depression-associated linguistic and acoustic speech features from picture-description tasks in patients with Alzheimer's disease [Research Paper](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364278).
  * *Digital and Biological Twins:* A review outlines the current applications of biological and digital twins (such as organoids and in silico models) in cardiometabolic drug development [Research Paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42820291/).
  * *Survival Estimator Methodology:* Analysis of TCGA breast cancer data revealed material model dependence in doubly robust survival estimators within small cohorts, proposing a parameter-to-information ratio to evaluate the reliability of nuisance regressions [Research Paper](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364358).

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Eli Lilly, Boehringer Ingelheim, and AbbVie detail obesity and metabolic candidates at EASD](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/3-takeaways-from-european-obesity-scientific-meeting/831870/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * At the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) annual meeting in Milan, Eli Lilly showcased data on its next-generation weight-loss pipeline, highlighting retatrutide (a triple GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist) and an experimental amylin-tirzepatide combination.
  * Fast-followers Boehringer Ingelheim and AbbVie presented early-to-mid stage clinical data on metabolic and obesity drug candidates in-licensed to break into the market currently dominated by Lilly and Novo Nordisk.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Regeneron reports Phase 2 COURAGE data for trevogrumab in GLP-1-induced muscle loss](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105684627142713394)** — *BioStocks*
  * Phase 2 COURAGE trial confirmed trevogrumab prevents lean mass and muscle loss during GLP-1 receptor agonist-induced weight loss.
  * In a predefined MRI substudy, trevogrumab prevented 70% of muscle loss associated with semaglutide treatment.

* **[TMS augmentation of behavioral therapy demonstrates safety and target engagement in tic disorders](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364036)** — *Research Paper*
  * A 3-arm, double-blind, sham-controlled Phase I trial (n = 50, ages 12–21) evaluated repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) to the supplementary motor area (SMA) to augment Comprehensive Behavioral Intervention for Tics (CBIT).
  * The combination of 1Hz rTMS or continuous theta burst stimulation (cTBS) with CBIT was safe and feasible (96% completion rate) and demonstrated successful neural target engagement on fMRI.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Eli Lilly initiates Phase III study of olomorasib in KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42823821/)** — *Research Paper*
  * The Phase III SUNRAY-02 trial is evaluating the efficacy and safety of the KRAS G12C inhibitor olomorasib combined with immunotherapy.
  * The trial focuses on patients with stage II–III KRAS G12C-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) following definitive therapy.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Roche's atezolizumab fails to show overall survival benefit when added to SBRT in early-stage NSCLC](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01816-7/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
  * The Phase III SWOG/NRG S1914 randomized clinical trial compared overall survival in 417 medically inoperable, high-risk patients with early-stage NSCLC.
  * Adding perioperative atezolizumab (neoadjuvant, concurrent, and adjuvant) to stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) did not improve overall survival compared to SBRT alone.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[BMS's mavacamten demonstrates durable efficacy in real-world underserved oHCM cohort](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364363)** — *Research Paper*
  * A retrospective observational study tracked 72 patients (67 initiated treatment, mean age 66.9 years, 72% female) with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) treated with mavacamten for up to 48 weeks.
  * Despite significant structural barriers in an underserved urban cohort in the Bronx, NY, patients achieved significant and sustained clinical and echocardiographic improvements.

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Target trial emulation confirms atorvastatin safety signals in Medicare population](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360302)** — *Research Paper*
  * Using Medicare fee-for-service claims (2017–2019) for statin-naive beneficiaries aged ≥65 years hospitalized for myocardial or cerebral infarction, researchers performed sequential target trial emulations.
  * The causal inference framework confirmed previously identified adverse drug event (ADE) signals associated with atorvastatin initiation.

* **[Biotech]** **[Nektar expands Phase 3 rezpegaldesleukin program and presents durability data](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105655395435921841)** — *BioStocks*
  * Initiated a third Phase 3 trial in the ZENITH AD program, expanding evaluation into treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients; the Phase 3 ZENITH AA study in alopecia areata is scheduled to begin in early 2027.
  * In alopecia areata, a Severity of Alopecia Tool (SALT) score ≤20 response was maintained in 75% of patients at 4 months off treatment and 63% at 6 months off treatment.
  * Hair regrowth continued through 6 months off treatment, with 19% of patients achieving a SALT score ≤10 (up from 7% at the end of 52 weeks of treatment).

* **[PEACE trial protocol compares dexmedetomidine and midazolam in acute ischemic stroke](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364377)** — *Research Paper*
  * The prospective, randomized, open-label, multicenter PEACE trial (N = 810) will evaluate conscious sedation using dexmedetomidine versus midazolam.
  * The trial is enrolling patients with acute ischemic stroke due to anterior circulation large vessel occlusion undergoing endovascular thrombectomy.

* **[Anakinra evaluated in COVID-19 using REMAP-CAP exploratory biomarkers](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42823695/)** — *Research Paper*
  * An exploratory analysis of the immune modulation domain of the REMAP-CAP trial investigated plasma ferritin and soluble urokinase plasminogen activator receptor (suPAR) levels.
  * The study evaluated these biomarkers as treatable traits to predict response and target treatment with the IL-1 receptor antagonist anakinra in critically ill COVID-19 patients.

* **[Meta-analysis assesses placental products for diabetic foot ulcers](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42820316/)** — *Research Paper*
  * A systematic review and meta-analysis of 12-week randomized controlled trials evaluated the efficacy of cellular, acellular, and matrix-like placental products in accelerating healing rates of diabetic foot ulcers.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[FDA approves first size-adjustable pediatric heart valve](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-heart-valve-designed-grow-children)** — *FDA*
  * The FDA approved the Autus Size-Adjustable Valve, a surgically implanted pulmonary heart valve for pediatric patients with congenital pulmonary valve disease.
  * The device is the first heart valve designed to be mechanically expanded post-surgery to accommodate a child’s physical growth. It is also the first U.S.-approved valve to utilize polymeric material rather than animal-derived tissue for its leaflets.

* **[FDA establishes CDER Center for Clinical Trial Innovation (C3TI)](http://www.fda.gov/about-fda/center-drug-evaluation-and-research-cder/cder-center-clinical-trial-innovation-c3ti)** — *FDA*
  * CDER launched C3TI as a central hub to test, implement, and scale innovative clinical trial methodologies (such as decentralized trials and novel digital health technologies) through enhanced communication with sponsors.
  * The center is managing a Demonstration Program to provide sponsors under active INDs/pre-INDs with timely feedback from FDA review staff on trial designs for new drug approvals or labeling changes.

* **[Biotech]** **[Cullinan Therapeutics initiates zipalertinib NDA submission under RTOR](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105825722791027200)** — *BioStocks*
  * Initiated NDA submission for zipalertinib in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
  * The submission is being conducted under the FDA's Real-Time Oncology Review (RTOR) program.

* **[Biotech]** **[Replimune launches TUDRIQEV in the U.S. for advanced melanoma](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2105750107065024531)** — *BioStocks*
  * TUDRIQEV is now commercially available in the U.S. for the treatment of advanced melanoma.

* **[Greenwich Rx recalls compounded glutathione injection](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/greenwich-rx-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-compounded-glutathione-due-elevated-endotoxin-levels)** — *FDA*
  * Greenwich Rx, a 503A compounding pharmacy, issued a voluntary nationwide recall of specific lots of compounded glutathione injection.
  * The recall was initiated due to potential elevated endotoxin levels, which pose risks of vascular inflammatory reactions or shock.

* **FDA updates and workshops:**
  * *Model-Informed Drug Development (ICH M15):* FDA announced an October 29, 2026 webinar to discuss implementation and documentation under the newly finalized ICH M15 guideline [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/webinar-stakeholder-engagement-new-final-guideline-general-principles-model-informed-drug).
  * *Cheminformatics & Submission Updates:* FDA announced its Drug Registration and Listing Workshop (Sept 29, 2026) and the Cheminformatics Resources of U.S. Governmental Organizations Workshop (April 12–14, 2027) [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fdas-drug-registration-and-listing-workshop-compliance-regulatory-and-submission-updates-09292026).

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi and Regeneron expand long-acting immunology antibody alliance](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/sanofi-regeneron-alliance-expanded-dupixent-immunology-drugs-development/831894/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Sanofi and Regeneron expanded their immunology alliance to co-develop and co-commercialize four long-acting, Regeneron-invented antibodies targeting IL-13 and/or IL-4 to build on the success of Dupixent.
  * The most advanced candidate, REGN20423, is currently in an early-stage clinical trial for eczema; the remaining three candidates are scheduled to enter human testing in 2027.

* **[China's biopharma pipeline grows to half of the global total](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/01/biotech-news-journey-to-witness-chinas-biotech-boom-up-close/)** — *STAT*
  * A close look at Shanghai's biotech hub highlights that Chinese-designed drugs now account for roughly half of the global development pipeline, increasing strategic competition for U.S.-based developers.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[HHS launches "Surpass" and ARPA-H initiatives to accelerate clinical trials](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/hhs-clinical-trial-speed-arpa-h-drug-testing/831909/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) unveiled the five-year "Surpass" program to restructure clinical research into continuous learning systems rather than sequential, disconnected trials.
  * Concurrently, ARPA-H initiated three projects to accelerate trial enrollment, develop nationwide data infrastructure, and enhance patient empowerment during clinical research.

* **[Small-quantity lipid-based nutritional supplements boost measles vaccination coverage](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04675-1)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A pragmatic, cluster-randomized trial in Yobe State, Nigeria, demonstrated that distributing small-quantity lipid-based nutrient supplements alongside routine immunization services significantly increased measles vaccination uptake in children aged 12–23 months.

* **[Fiji declares national emergency over HIV spike](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01983-5/fulltext?rss=yes)** — *The Lancet*
  * Fiji’s Health Minister declared HIV a national emergency following a major surge in cases, initiating a coordinated, whole-of-government approach to address the outbreak.

* **[Influenza modeling suggests 5% vaccination increase significantly lowers pediatric burden](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.26363797)** — *Research Paper*
  * A compartmental model simulating the 2022/23–2024/25 influenza seasons in the U.S. estimated that increasing vaccine coverage or vaccine effectiveness by 5 percentage points would significantly reduce pediatric influenza hospitalizations and mortality.

* **[Continuous glucose monitoring demonstrates feasibility and efficacy in Kenyan pediatric public-sector clinics](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.29.26364323)** — *Research Paper*
  * A single-arm prospective study evaluated CGM implementation in 40 patients (ages 4–25) with type 1 diabetes at a tertiary public hospital in Nairobi, Kenya.
  * Over three months, with a median sensor wear time of 89.0%, the cohort's adjusted mean HbA1c fell significantly from 10.82% to 9.42%.

* **[Racial disparities in heart failure linked to structural inflammatory burden](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.28.26364238)** — *Research Paper*
  * An analysis of 6,785 participants followed for 16 years in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) evaluated the association of four baseline inflammatory/hemostatic biomarkers (IL-6, CRP, fibrinogen, and D-dimer) with incident heart failure.
  * The study quantified the extent to which structural environmental determinants shaping systemic inflammatory burden account for Black-White disparities in heart failure incidence.

* **[Age-stratified diagnostic delay in pertussis limits transmission control](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.25.26364016)** — *Research Paper*
  * A retrospective cohort study of 787 patients with confirmed pertussis found that while same-day diagnosis was highest in children aged 1–4 years (75.4%), diagnostic delay was common in adults.
  * Among the 38.8% of patients with delayed diagnoses, the median delay ranged from 7–12 days in children to 22.5–26.5 days in adults aged ≥50 years, delaying treatment and transmission containment.

* **Policy & Funding Updates:**
  * *NIH Funding Shifts:* NIH continued to reduce grant funding for research involving health disparities, race, and ethnicity during the 2026 fiscal year [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/02/nih-grant-funding-fy2026-analysis/).
  * *Pennsylvania Measles:* A fifth measles death in Pennsylvania highlights ongoing challenges in tracking the precise scope of localized outbreaks [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/02/health-news-how-big-is-pennsylvania-measles-outbreak/).
  * *Medicare Advantage 2027 Shifts:* In 2027, Medicare Advantage plans are projected to keep premiums stable but increase deductibles and reduce benefits, shifting more healthcare costs to seniors [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/01/medicare-advantage-plans-have-higher-deductibles-fewer-benefits-in-2027/).
  * *CDC Disability Questions:* Disability advocates criticized the CDC's proposed health survey redesign, warning that removing specific disability questions will result in undercounting [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/01/cdc-health-survey-redesign-removes-questions-about-disabilities/).
  * *NHS Palantir Campaign:* Activists held a day of action protesting the NHS's major data platform contract with Palantir [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)01982-3/fulltext?rss=yes).

**Worth watching:** CDER's newly established Center for Clinical Trial Innovation (C3TI) and its Demonstration Program as a barometer for how quickly the FDA will adopt and standardize decentralized and digital-health-enabled clinical trial protocols.
